summary: OpenAI announced that insurer Travelers deployed a fully autonomous voice-based AI Claim Assistant, built on OpenAI's Realtime API and frontier models, nationwide for handling first-notice-of-loss auto claims.

mechanisms.reason: A nationwide autonomous voice assistant now handles the bulk of claim-filing interactions for a company processing over a million claims a year, representing a high-volume real-time inference deployment.
mechanisms.quote: After launching in eight states, Travelers expanded the assistant countrywide within two months, with 85–90% of customers using the AI Assistant now completing their claim filing through AI.

practices.reason: The case study describes connecting models to internal claims infrastructure and orchestration systems but gives no transferable protocol, API, or integration detail an engineering team could act on.
practices.quote: Behind the scenes, Travelers connected OpenAI models to its claims infrastructure, orchestration systems, and internal tools to safely operate at enterprise scale.
